summary: The SonarQube Cloud Quality Gate for Parent Draft PR #90 exact head d99eafd76d9fdbef5b63a19d084fd2d7caff6c08 was ERROR: 15.9% duplicated new code against a maximum of 3% and Reliability C where A is required. root_cause: The first Go-centralization implementation copied most of the existing Python updater's transport, strict JSON, regular-file, atomic-write, CLI, test-fixture, and test-harness mechanics into separate Go-specific files. This preserved behavior but creates task-owned duplication. Its static CodeQL workflow parser also uses an ambiguous multiline regex boundary which Sonar classifies as a reliability Bug. The later d99eafd follow-up changes only Framework-cache compatibility tests and bilingual Change Records, and is not causal.
root_cause_de: Die erste Go-Zentralisierungs-Implementierung kopierte den Großteil der vorhandenen Python-Updater-Mechaniken für Transport, striktes JSON, Regular-File, atomisches Schreiben, CLI, Test-Fixture und Test-Harness in getrennte Go-spezifische Dateien. Dies bewahrt Verhalten, erzeugt jedoch aufgabeneigene Duplikation. Der statische CodeQL-Workflow-Parser verwendet außerdem eine mehrzeilige Regex-Grenze mit mehrdeutiger Präzedenz, die Sonar als Reliability-Bug einstuft. Der spätere d99eafd-Follow-up ändert nur Framework-Cache-Kompatibilitätstests und zweisprachige Change Records und ist nicht ursächlich.
proposed_remediation: Replace the ambiguous static-workflow regex boundary with an explicit parser or explicitly grouped safe boundary and regression coverage. Extract shared updater mechanics into one internal Parent module, keep Python- and Go-specific endpoint/schema/version policy adapters separate, and extract the duplicated response/opener test harness. Preserve all fail-closed security invariants, then rerun focused tests and a fresh exact-head SonarQube Cloud analysis.
proposed_remediation_de: Ersetze die mehrdeutige Static-Workflow-Regex-Grenze durch einen expliziten Parser oder eine explizit gruppierte sichere Grenze samt Regression-Coverage. Extrahiere gemeinsame Updater-Mechaniken in ein internes Parent-Modul, belasse Python- und Go-spezifische Endpoint-/Schema-/Version-Policy-Adapter getrennt und extrahiere den duplizierten Response-/Opener-Test-Harness. Bewahre alle fail-closed-Sicherheitsinvarianten und führe danach fokussierte Tests sowie eine frische Exact-Head-SonarQube-Cloud-Analyse aus.
acceptance_criteria: The exact static Go contract has no task-owned python:S5850 reliability issue and retains all previous rejection cases.
Shared updater mechanics preserve exact official endpoint validation before network access, no redirects, bounded strict JSON parsing, and symlink-safe atomic update semantics.
Python and Go adapters retain their distinct release schemas, supported version-series policies, command-line flags, JSON shapes, and fail-closed error behavior.
The exact follow-up PR head has no task-owned reliability Bug and SonarQube Cloud reports duplicated new-code density at or below 3% without forbidden workaround.
Focused unit, workflow-contract, bilingual-documentation, diff, security-diff, and current-head hosted validation evidence pass; Update submodules is not dispatched and master is not merged.

Run the Go-version and Python-version contract tests plus CI-security workflow tests and repository check targets.
Run documentation parity and git diff --check.

Commit and normally push only the focused remediation; verify local, remote, and PR head SHA equality and wait for fresh exact-head SonarQube Cloud and GitHub checks.

A newer supported patch updates only the matching central version file when the separately resolved expected version matches.
